blocks.h: Trees in a park, 200 trees (example data)

questions.q: A survey of 80 pupils: 45% walk, 30% car, 25% bus. How many each?
Yusuf says: 'Class A's 50% is always more people than class B's 25%.' True? Explain.
questions.a: Not always: it depends on the totals (50% of 20 = 10, 25% of 80 = 20)

questions.q: 50% of a pie chart is... A) 180° B) 50° C) 90°
Big question: how do percentages fit?
questions.a: The whole circle is 100%; find each percentage of the total
